parser_facts: the known-valid Unit 001 VBE instance uses target.program_version == 0.5
the pre-correction Unit 002-R VBE instance uses target.program_version == 0.8
program_version is a compiler protocol discriminator and does not encode the source consequence, target expressions, world partition, fact status, evidence, or desired verdict

correction.rationale: Infrastructure v0.8 names the prospective execution harness. The frozen v0.7 scientific core consumes consequence-blind program grammar version 0.5, so the harness version must not be written into target.program_version.

allowed_changes: Change only target.program_version in the Unit 002-R draft and accepted VBE instances from 0.8 to 0.5, in addition to the distinct adapter_version correction already authorized by Amendment 004.
Mechanically update the dependent envelope SHA/commit pointers in both instances after Amendment 004 changes vbe.envelope.json.
Mechanically update AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json to bind the corrected envelope and draft bytes and to disclose Amendments 004 and 005.
Generate a fresh manifest and readiness seal from the corrected committed authoring bytes under new filenames so the superseded pre-Amendment readiness bytes remain available as immutable history.
forbidden_changes: Changing any source consequence, source coordinate, admissibility condition, bounded world, or effect cut.
Changing any target expression in discriminator, operative_signature, mechanism, or interpreter.
Changing any target fact ID, fact status, provenance relation, evidence binding, qualification binding, target revision, operation identity, or runtime carrier evidence.
Changing the PRESERVED_COMPARE pattern or choosing another pattern because of the invalid execution attempt.
Replacing, reordering, or reselecting the prospectively enrolled Unit 002 target.
Using parser inspection to infer or prefer a semantic verdict.
scientific_interpretation: The program_version correction changes only which frozen compiler grammar recognizes the already-frozen consequence-blind program. The discriminator, operative signature, mechanism, interpreter, required facts, evidence, worlds, and consequence mapping remain unchanged.
relationship_to_amendment_004: Amendment 004 corrects the outer Projection Adapter protocol label from 0.8 to 0.7. Amendment 005 separately corrects the inner consequence-blind program protocol label from 0.8 to 0.5. Both were identified before any valid Unit 002-R semantic outcome.
